translations.web: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
translations.bsb: All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view. And if you think differently about some issue, God will reveal this to you as well.
translations.kjv: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
translations.asv: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, be thus minded: and if in anything ye are otherwise minded, this also shall God reveal unto you:
